label: Complete
description: Carries every registered tool. For a caller that knows what it wants and would rather not have anything chosen for it.
guidance:
This profile carries every tool the server registers, in registration order, with the server's own wording. It makes no judgement about what suits you, which is exactly the point: take it when you already know which tools you want and would rather not have a surface chosen on your behalf.

The cost is real. Every listed tool contributes its full schema to each `tools/list`, so a large surface spends context before any work happens. If you find yourself ignoring most of it, build a narrower profile with `define_model_profile`.
workflow: Skim the listing once to learn what exists.
Narrow it with define_model_profile once you know your working set.
